name: Todos
description: Your todos on a screen made of Zeff's own kit: grouped by urgency, with the ones you wait on, done and the workers' — tick, flag, set aside, dismiss, a due day, add.

views.name: Todos
views.template: {{#if state.part == 'todos' and state.scope != 'activity' and not data.x}}Loading …{{#else}}

items.title: Tick a todo off, dismiss it, open it again

flow.name: todos-ext.status
flow.title: Tick a todo off, dismiss it, open it again
flow.description: A todo's status (input id, status: open | done | dismissed, early). Output { ok, id, confirm, error } — confirm: a repeat ticked off a week or more before its day asks first.

flow.name: todos-ext.flag
flow.title: Flag a todo as important
flow.description: A todo flagged important or not (input id, flagged).

items.title: Set a todo aside — or back up

flow.name: todos-ext.defer
flow.title: Set a todo aside — or back up
flow.description: A todo put to the bottom for now or taken back up (input id, deferred).

flow.name: todos-ext.due
flow.title: A todo's due day
flow.description: A todo's due day (input id, due: YYYY-MM-DD, empty for none).

flow.name: todos-ext.add
flow.title: Add a todo
flow.description: A todo of yours through the gate every todo goes through (input text, ticket, due). Output { id, ref, merged } — merged: it said the same as an open one.

flow.name: todos-ext.text
flow.title: A todo's words
flow.description: A todo's text changed (input id, text).

flow.name: todos-ext.note
flow.title: A note on a todo
flow.description: Your note on a todo (input id, text). Output { ok, message, error }.

items.title: Take a note off a todo

flow.name: todos-ext.note-remove
flow.title: Take a note off a todo
flow.description: Your note on a todo taken away (input id, at: the note's time).

flow.name: todos-ext.time
flow.title: Time spent on a todo
flow.description: Time you spent, by hand (input id, minutes, note).

items.title: Take an action off a todo

flow.name: todos-ext.op-remove
flow.title: Take an action off a todo
flow.description: One of a todo's actions taken off it (input id, index).

items.title: The activity you have looked at

flow.name: todos-ext.seen
flow.title: The activity you have looked at
flow.description: The newest event of the todos' activity you have seen (input id).

items.title: Take back a briefing run's todos

flow.name: todos-ext.undo-run
flow.title: Take back a briefing run's todos
flow.description: The todos a run made that you haven't touched are dismissed (input run). Output { dismissed, kept, claims }.

items.title: Run the briefing now — or stop it

flow.name: todos-ext.board-run
flow.title: Run the briefing now — or stop it
flow.description: The Ticket-Lage's run started (Jira synced first) or, with stop, stopped. Output { ok, message }.

items.title: A change the briefing suggests on a ticket

flow.name: todos-ext.ticket-action
flow.title: A change the briefing suggests on a ticket
flow.description: One suggested change (transition, assignee, comment) done in Jira (input run, ticket, idx). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.follow
flow.title: Follow a ticket
flow.description: A ticket followed (1), no longer followed (-1) or as it comes (0) (input key, value).

items.title: Write the recap of a day

flow.name: todos-ext.recap-start
flow.title: Write the recap of a day
flow.description: The day gathered and summarized by the AI, in the background (input day). Output { ok, message }.

flow.name: todos-ext.recurrence
flow.title: Make a todo come back
flow.description: A todo that comes back every day, week, month or year, or not (input id, freq: daily | weekly | monthly | yearly | empty).

items.title: Make a repeat's appointments and actions again

flow.name: todos-ext.regenerate
flow.title: Make a repeat's appointments and actions again
flow.description: A recurring todo's calendar appointments and its actions made again (input id). Output { ok, message }.

flow.name: todos-ext.note-edit
flow.title: Change a note
flow.description: Your note on a todo changed (input id, at, text).

flow.name: todos-ext.note-sync
flow.title: Put a note on Jira
flow.description: Your note on a todo posted on its ticket as a comment (input id, at). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.instruct
flow.title: An instruction to Copilot
flow.description: Your instruction on a todo done by the Copilot CLI (input id, text). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.draft
flow.title: Draft a reply
flow.description: A reply drafted by the AI from the conversation, never sent (input id). Output { ok, text, channel, to, openUrl, error }.

items.title: Bring a reply's page to the front

flow.name: todos-ext.open-reply
flow.title: Bring a reply's page to the front
flow.description: The page a reply goes to brought to the front in the automation Chrome (input url).

flow.name: todos-ext.suggest
flow.title: The AI proposes actions
flow.description: The AI proposes the actions for a todo now (input id). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.alternative
flow.title: Do a todo another way
flow.description: One of a todo's other ways done (input id, label). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.worked-on
flow.title: Worked on it
flow.description: A booking suggestion for the todo (input id). Output { ok, message }.

items.title: Take a time record off a todo

flow.name: todos-ext.time-delete
flow.title: Take a time record off a todo
flow.description: A time record taken away (input id: the record's).

items.title: Take a context off a todo

flow.name: todos-ext.context-dismiss
flow.title: Take a context off a todo
flow.description: What a todo is shown to come from taken off it (input id, ref).

items.title: Change the text an action would send

flow.name: todos-ext.op-text
flow.title: Change the text an action would send
flow.description: The text of one of a todo's actions changed (input id, index, text). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.transfer
flow.title: Change a transfer's fields
flow.description: A transfer on a todo changed (input id, index, name, iban, bic, amount, purpose). Output { ok, message, error }.

items.title: The todos you have looked at

flow.name: todos-ext.list-seen
flow.title: The todos you have looked at
flow.description: Now is kept as the time up to which you have seen the todos (what is newer shows as new).

items.title: An action done in your browser

flow.name: todos-ext.browser-done
flow.title: An action done in your browser
flow.description: An action you did yourself taken off the todo and noted (input id, index). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.ask
flow.title: Ask about a ticket
flow.description: A question about a ticket answered from what Zeff knows (input ticket, question). Output { ok, answer, sources, id, error }.

items.title: Take an answer out of a ticket's chat

flow.name: todos-ext.chat-dismiss
flow.title: Take an answer out of a ticket's chat
flow.description: An answer taken out of the context (input id).

flow.name: todos-ext.resolve
flow.title: A comment done — or not
flow.description: A Jira or GitLab comment marked done here or taken back (input kind: jira | gitlab, key, ticket, resolved).

flow.name: todos-ext.board-settings
flow.title: Which tickets the briefing reads
flow.description: The briefing's JQL filter (input jql). Output { ok, message, error }.

items.title: Run a sync step — or stop it

flow.name: todos-ext.sync
flow.title: Run a sync step — or stop it
flow.description: One of Zeff's sync steps started or stopped (input key, stop). Output { ok, message, error }.

flow.name: todos-ext.run
flow.title: Run a todo's actions now
flow.description: A todo's actions run by you, right now (input id, only: the place of one action — empty: all). Output { message }.
